description:
All systems are go for DEF CON Singapore 2! We’re excited to announce our return to Singapore 4-6 March, 2027.
Even better, DCSG2 follows directly after Black Hat Singapore. For BH attendees it’s a perfect opportunity to make a week of it.
We’ll be opening online registration soon.

We’re back at the lovely and capacious Marina Bay Sands, and we’re bringing the whole DEF CON experience with us. World class talks, immersive Villages, contests and entertainment.

Of course, if you want to do more than just attend, watch this space. Now that the dates are set we’ll be posting Calls for Papers, Contests, Villages, Communities, and Entertainment. The opportunities to participate are legion.

title: DEF CON Singapore Dates!
